thread:
ryan (AE): Heads-up: Pioneer Retail moved the POC to their exec review. CISO wants explicit EU data residency, a short SLA appendix for GPU failover behavior, and a written temporary overage cap for months 1-3. They asked for a CRO-level briefing next Thu.
sophia (Solutions Eng): We can guarantee eu-west-1 residency for inference and logs. Fallback path is automatic in-region CPU variant; I'll draft the SLA appendix and include expected perf deltas. Do they want a network topology sketch?
mike (CS): CISO also asked about audit log retention (they want 180 days) and SAML key rotation cadence. I have their questionnaire; two items open: rotation frequency and evidence of log export.
ryan (AE): Customer asked if we can cap token overage at $8,000/month for the first three months. @alina can Legal draft a short amendment?
alina (Legal): We can do a time-limited amendment. Need confirmation cap applies to token consumption only or total invoice. Also confirm if cap ties to included quota at POC start.
ben (Product): SLA blurb suggestion: "Regional availability SLA 99.9%; automatic in-region fallback to a CPU-compatible variant when GPU capacity is constrained; telemetry and per-route latency exposed to customer console." I'll add p50/p95 delta bullets.
sophia (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a minimal topology diagram and a one-page appendix. Note: CPU fallback increases inference latency and per-token CPU costs; call that out.
mike (CS): I'll confirm with Pioneer whether $8k covers tokens only. Also will send the SAML rotation evidence they requested.
ryan (AE): If we can get amendment + appendix by Wed AM I can schedule CRO for Thu 10:00 CET. Need legal sign-off before CRO joins.
alina (Legal): If customer confirms tokens-only cap today I can produce a draft amendment by tomorrow EOD. Template snippet I plan to use: "Trial overage cap: Provider will limit Customer's monthly overage charges attributable to token-based inference to $8,000 for months 1-3. Overage defined as token consumption above included quota."
ben (Product): Approved phrasing. I'll include a short table mapping fallback model identities to expected perf delta: e.g., "gpu-x -> cpu-q (p50 +30ms, p95 +200ms)".
sophia (Solutions Eng): Uploaded draft appendix + diagram: https://drive.internal/redwood/pioneer-retail/poc/appendix_v1.pdf
calendar-bot: Meeting proposed: "Pioneer Retail Exec Briefing" Thu 10:00 CET - tentative invite sent to ryan, sophia, mike, alina, ben
mike (CS): Pioneer confirmed tokens-only cap = $8,000/mo. Also confirmed they need audit logs retained 180 days; I'll note that in the amendment bundle.
ryan (AE): Thanks. Next steps checklist: 1) Alina -> amendment draft with $8k tokens-only cap (ETA: tomorrow EOD) 2) Sophia -> finalize appendix + diag (ETA: Wed AM) 3) Ben -> perf table (ETA: Wed AM) 4) Mike -> upload SAML evidence + log-retention note (DONE). I'll post pre-brief agenda once amendment lands. :thumbsup:
